operational_learning.text: A delegate in the main checkout's .scratch is harvested into tracked harvesting/ at the next SessionStart catch-up. A verifier that saves the issue or the commander's extracted prompts as .json there leaks them toward a tracked path; save such copies with a .tmp suffix (done here: prompts.json.tmp, issue180.json.tmp). The AAR files at <session scratch dir>/*-aar.json are harvested too until S-14 ships

A background level-1 delegate can find its own agentId while running from <parent session dir>/subagents/*.meta.json by matching its description (here agent-a2f5dd4305cffdf2a); the parent transcript also contains several agentIds near the mission name, so the meta.json match is the unambiguous one

rfis.title: How the implementing mission updates the plan's status table
rfis.question: The brief orders the delegate to update plans/structured-reports/implementation-plan.md after every batch, while forbidding pushes to main and giving the main checkout read-only.
